categories.main_business_segments: Jin Tong Ling Technology Group primarily operates in industrial centrifugal blowers, centrifugal air compressors, high-efficiency steam turbines, industrial boilers, and hydrogen fuel cell air compressors manufacturing. It also engages in system integration services including power island integration, high-pressure air station integration, ice storage systems, seawater ice-making systems, and energy-saving retrofit projects. The company provides EPC, BOT, and BOO project contracting and operation services, focusing on new energy, renewable energy, and energy-saving environmental protection sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent R&D and technological innovation, with a provincial-level R&D center. It utilizes advanced processing and testing equipment, CFD technology for aerodynamic design, and proprietary technologies such as tungsten carbide spraying and welding. Key developments include high-efficiency narrow flow fans, ultra-low temperature steam compressors, high and medium pressure steam turbines, dual-channel high-temperature boilers, and hydrogen fuel cell air compressors. It also applies distributed control systems and develops energy storage technologies like electric storage cooling and heating.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jin Tong Ling serves customers in power generation, environmental protection, building materials, petrochemical, metallurgy, commerce, and military sectors. Its products are widely used in wastewater treatment, desulfurization and denitrification in power plants and steel mills, chemical, pharmaceutical, solar thermal power, biomass power, waste incineration, heat and power cogeneration, and hydrogen energy. Major customers include large steel companies, energy service providers, and government-related entities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters in Nantong, Jiangsu Province. It also has overseas projects and markets in Southeast Asia including Pakistan, Thailand, the Philippines, and India, and is expanding into Russia and Central Asia. Subsidiaries and joint ventures are located in Shanghai, Wuxi, Guangxi, Heilongjiang, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jin Tong Ling operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain as a manufacturer and system integrator of high-end fluid machinery and energy systems. It provides customized equipment manufacturing, system integration, project contracting, and operation services, positioning itself as a comprehensive energy management solutions provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on high-end equipment manufacturing, system integration, and operation services aligned with national 'dual carbon' and green development strategies. R&D priorities include energy-saving blowers and compressors, high-parameter steam turbines, hydrogen fuel cell compressors, biomass and waste heat power generation technologies, and energy storage systems such as molten salt thermal storage. It emphasizes digital transformation, intelligent manufacturing, and quality improvement to enhance competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of industrial blowers, compressors, turbines, boilers, and related equipment. Additional income comes from system integration contracts (EPC, BOT, BOO), operation services, and energy management contracts. The company also earns from government subsidies, investment income, and asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Jin Tong Ling is positioned as a high-end equipment manufacturer and system integrator in the strategic emerging industry of efficient and energy-saving general equipment manufacturing. It competes with domestic and international manufacturers in industrial blowers, compressors, turbines, and boilers. The company leverages its R&D capabilities, project execution experience, and system integration services to maintain a competitive edge, especially in renewable energy and environmental protection sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Jin Tong Ling reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.45 billion, a 6.6% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 505 million. The company faces challenges from market demand fluctuations, intensified competition, and asset impairment. Despite the downturn, it continues investing in R&D with expenditures around RMB 87 million and maintains a workforce of over 1,500 employees. The company is undergoing restructuring and cost optimization to improve profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jin Tong Ling emphasizes customized design, high efficiency, and energy-saving performance in its products. It differentiates itself through integrated system solutions combining equipment manufacturing with project contracting and operation services. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, proprietary technologies, and successful demonstration projects provide customers with reliable, advanced, and environmentally friendly energy solutions tailored to their needs.
